unit: published research article; one paper can have multiple actual-use data sources
principle: Count physical measurement families from actually analyzed inputs or evaluation targets, not introductory mentions, platforms, tensor ranks, or alternative transforms of the same signal.

seismic_elastic.description: Elastic ground motion or strain, including conventional seismic and DAS; distinguish sensing types.

geodetic_position_displacement.description: Direct positioning or local displacement/strain instrumentation, separately from radar-derived deformation.

radar_backscatter_interferometry.description: Active microwave radar amplitude, phase or polarimetry, including InSAR; not optical because it is an image.

optical_reflectance.description: Passive visible/near-infrared/shortwave-infrared reflectance and derived products.

thermal_radiance.description: Thermal infrared or other emitted thermal radiometry, distinct from reflected optical bands.

atmospheric_in_situ.description: Atmospheric state and composition from local sensors.

hydrologic_in_situ.description: Water, soil and groundwater state/flux observations.

oceanographic_in_situ.description: Marine state/flux observations other than seismic motion.

gravity_potential.description: Gravitational field or potential measurements and derived gravity products.

electromagnetic_electrical.description: Non-radar electromagnetic, electrical or magnetic geophysical measurements.

geochemical_biological.description: Material composition, isotope and biological/ecological assays; separate fine types when scientifically needed.

human_system_records.description: Trade, infrastructure, agricultural, demographic or other human-system records.

other.description: Specify a justified additional measurement family, including lidar or acoustic ocean measurements pending ontology review; do not force these into optical or seismic.

integration_relations_multilabel.co_used_only: Distinct families actually analyzed in the same paper but no integrated estimator or common learned model evidenced.
integration_relations_multilabel.joint_non_ml_inversion: Distinct families jointly constrain a non-ML estimator/inversion or physically based assimilation.
integration_relations_multilabel.late_output_fusion: Separately computed predictions or embeddings are combined downstream; record whether fusion itself is learned.
integration_relations_multilabel.joint_ml_inputs: A learned predictor consumes at least two actual measurement families; record whether concatenation or shared training.
integration_relations_multilabel.cross_modal_representation_learning: A learned representation explicitly couples distinct families, for example paired/contrastive/masked cross-family objectives.
integration_relations_multilabel.cross_modal_transfer_test: A prespecified empirical test evaluates transfer or prediction between families or robustness to held-out/missing modalities, not merely within-family temporal transfer.

foundation_model_assessment: Record authors' use of term and assessor's task/scale/pretraining evidence separately; architecture name or buzzword is insufficient.
edge_cases: A waveform and its spectrogram count as one source family.
Multiple channels or variables from one instrument do not automatically create multiple families.
DAS and seismometers share a broad elastic family but retain different fine sensing type labels.
GNSS and InSAR can measure a related deformation field while remaining different sensing families.
Radar and optical may both be raster images yet count as distinct families.
Simulated and observed examples of the same waveform family differ in origin, not necessarily modality count.
Reanalysis is not evidence that the paper directly consumes each underlying assimilated sensor family.
Training targets count toward source-family co-use but a target family alone does not prove that both families were used as joint model inputs.
Image plus acquisition timestamp or coordinates is not automatically cross-modal training; annotate metadata/context separately.
Independent papers using the same archive do not prove replication of the same method or access at the archive's full scale.
Absence from a title or abstract is unknown unless full evidence was assessed.
Three components of a seismic station remain one elastic family; GNSS and InSAR are two sensing families in this protocol but can map to one coarse deformation phenomenon.

counting_resolutions.sensitivity: coarser measured_phenomenon and finer sensing_type counts
counting_resolutions.requirement: publish mapping and report sensitivity rather than asserting a universal modality count

needs.rule: Publish expressed requests separately from inferred needs, and never treat use prevalence as desire for the proposed project.
